scope: D.C.1/2/3 only; static annotations, never execution
provenance: Native x86 PE static disassembly and local MES corpora, 2026-10-26

stream.stop.description: Decoder leaves PC at opcode 00; dispatcher sets a stop/yield flag. Not a one-byte NOP.

control.marker.description: Context-dependent 3-byte record: IF companion uses signed first byte as block ID; sum list terminator.

checkpoint.description: Combine bytes little-endian into checkpoint index; updates state and reads header u16 metadata. Not itself a jump.

block.marker.description: p0!=0: fall through. p0==0: forward-scan to next marker whose signed second byte equals p1, resume after it.

label.named.description: Named-label search uses exact NUL-terminated bytes and returns the label opcode PC.

jump.named.description: Resolve label from start PC 3; if missing or empty, leave PC unchanged. Dispatch has mode gates.

script.transfer.description: Load named script with mode 0, clear several UI/state fields; full transition effects unresolved.

script.transfer_alt.description: Load named script with mode 1; has different reset effects from mode 0.

script.entry_label.description: Store pending named entry label. Application/reset rules are profile-specific; DC3DD modes 0 and 1 share the apply-then-clear tail.

arguments.extend.description: Decoder absorbs one immediately following extension record into four extra signed words; not an independently dispatched command in that position.

variable.update.description: p3=0 set(bank,index,p2); p3=1 add; p3=2 subtract; other modes do nothing in this handler.

variable.sum_list.description: Following nine-byte records supply source bank/index pairs until opcode 02. Sum into destination p0,p1. Term opcode and last two words are ignored by the native loop; 02 is left for the decoder.

variable.add_variable.description: set(p0,p1,get(p0,p1)+get(p2,p3)); native-verified, absent from DC3DD corpus.

branch.compare.description: Compare get(p0,p1) with p2; if p3 low-byte bit7 set, RHS=get(p2>>8,p2&255), compare mode=p3&127. Modes 0..5: == != > < >= <= (signed comparison). Consume next 3 bytes; signed first operand is block ID. True falls through; false uses block scan.

host.command_with_string.description: Consumes the next opcode-plus-NUL-string record as a payload and advances PC past it; passes four words and the string to a UI helper. Payload is not dispatched as a named jump. UI effects unresolved.

wait.message.description: DD 06: state+444F4 nonzero suppresses wait; otherwise consume state+196FC once or yield native reason 6. Operands are unused in this handler. Requires a flow-aware host.

text.speaker.description: DD 64: decode text, apply the input-length sakura alias rule and 420CE0 preprocessing, store the speaker buffer. Does not itself wait.

text.body.description: DD 65: prepare body buffer; next non-06 instruction in normal mode causes reason 8 before consuming that instruction. Full audio/prefix/inline effects require host implementations.

history.range.description: DD normal-play host binding; unimplemented submodes fail in Dc3Host. See docs/DC3DD_PLAYBACK.md.

wait.audio.description: Native asynchronous completion event; wait.audio absorbs successive opcode 15 masks.

media.movie.description: Native asynchronous completion event; wait.audio absorbs successive opcode 15 masks.

ui.origin.description: UI origin / texture subrectangle at relative destination; 74 requires 71 extension (width,height,slot flags,unused).

ui.image_quad.description: UI origin / texture subrectangle at relative destination; 74 requires 71 extension (width,height,slot flags,unused).

scene.character_overlay.description: Clear queued overlay / face with literal minus; other strings are native no-effect except overlay double-minus restore.

scene.face.description: Clear queued overlay / face with literal minus; other strings are native no-effect except overlay double-minus restore.

choice.item.description: Register label and consume following encoded caption; native 42B82B / 4159C0.

choice.show.description: Normal mode 0 presents registered choices and waits; replay modes unsupported. Native 42BBC5.

scene.center_background.description: Center the pending background at publication (4318CA, 431FAE..432066); renderer uses image dimensions.

scene.image_tone.description: 98 stores the pending actor color variant (0 unchanged, 1 *, 2 @); 431767, 41FCC0 and 44A1A0/44A2D0.

state.random.description: 24 stores MSVCRT rand() modulo p0 in special bank 99 index 2 (4302FA). Seed is portable and saved, not synchronized to native wall time.

scene.record_motion.description: A1 0 records object animation tracks; nonzero ends recording. 431B9C / 442810. Current implementation supports the corpus's recorded shake tracks.

scene.replay_motion.description: A2 repeats recorded animation tracks, 255 loops. 431BEA / 444C80.

scene.character_move.description: 88 linearly moves character p2 to p0,p1 over p3*6 ticks, or 60 when p3=0. p2 bit16 is native ignored path. 42FA90 / 443FF0.

scene.stop_motion.description: Stop all render-object motion tracks (4318A9). Current host tracks reviewed shake animations only.

system.version.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.template.description: 23 saves the current UI panel to a selector-dependent template and clears construction state. 0 and unused selector cases are native fallbacks.

ui.panel.description: 19/0 clears current UI and action bindings; other reviewed selectors save current UI in a template slot.

ui.resource.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.button_sound.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.button_sprite.description: 6D + 71 register cropped atlas quads for the pending button: reviewed states 99 normal, 1 hover, 2 pressed. Other native modes are partial.

ui.palette.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.action.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.wait.description: 0B flushes button construction and yields for an input action. A button label resumes the original MES, without falling through.

ui.flush.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.focus.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.text.description: p2=0 leaves the following record for dispatch; otherwise consumes the following encoded-string record and registers UI text. Active text rendering remains unimplemented.

ui.button_text.description: Consumes the next string record and registers state-specific button text metadata. Active text rendering remains unimplemented.

ui.text_style.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.pointer.description: DC3DD original UI host operation. Static native handler evidence: analysis/system-ui; implementation scope is strict and partial.

ui.confirm_position.description: Set confirmation origin and caption/remember ID; third operand is ignored by native dispatch.

ui.confirm.description: Instantiate original template 12 with indexed caption; yes/no use action slots 0/1, checkbox updates bank93; an enabled remember flag jumps directly to action0.

system.exit.description: Sends WM_DESTROY to the game window and yields; portable host ends the game Activity.

choice.caption.description: Encoded caption consumed by choice.item; independent dispatch uses the native fallback.

variable.update_indirect.description: Modes 0/1/2 assign/add/subtract. Mode 3 reads (p2, read(p0,p1)) into native result register 99:255; other modes have no effect.

jump.named_required.description: DM signed-opcode label scan, first exact label before opcode 00; empty or missing target enters native error state, never silently ignored.

block.marker_unsigned.description: DM p0==0 scans using unsigned p1 against a signed marker byte. Conditional companion IDs are signed separately; high-bit unconditional IDs must not be coerced.

dm.audio.completion_action.description: DC2DM 4305CA copies a music-event label to C22490 and resets C29250 after synchronizing the music event counter. Runtime currently implements the empty cancellation used by MUSIC exit; nonempty labels remain explicit failures.

ui.music_end_action.description: Menu-wait BGM-end callback: PC2 423571 consumes binding; DD 4340D7 retains binding and polls at >500ms until script clears it.

grid.item_action.description: Attach original byte-exact action label to current data entry (PC2 41D66D; DD 434530).

pc.grid.item.description: Append native list data entry: ID, reserved, source rectangle, resource selector, reserved (41D5A5).

dd.grid.item.description: Begin list data entry with ID and source rectangle (436070).

dd.grid.common_sprite.description: Common relative list sprite; state -1 configures scrollbar thumb, positioned from viewport bounds and offset (4346E0,435447).

dd.grid.item_sprite.description: Current entry overlay, relative destination, source XYWH and state (434550).

dd.grid.text.description: State 99 sets text color; other states consume next string as entry caption (4345F0).

dd.audio.seek.description: 43B9A0/42FC2C: set playback cursor by percentage; mode 0 music, 1 sound, otherwise movie audio.

ui.option_flag.description: 43178F calls 412DB0/412DC0: set UI object fields +348/+34C to 1, selected by operand 0; platform pointer constraints still under review.
